data_access: Only official LIBERO benchmark source and 40 BDDL files were read by this extractor; no experiment outcomes, policy outputs, run manifests, or path comparison data are inputs.

priority: unknown if unsupported or unresolved goal structure
rules.state_action: Open/Close/Turnon/Turnoff goal predicates or literal open/close/turn on/turn off commands in either official instruction source.
rules.state_preservation: A state goal literal already explicitly listed in :init is preservation when the instruction does not request that action; this is a declaration-based rule, not a simulation claim.
rules.placement_object_count: Count distinct first arguments of positive On/In goal predicates that refer to declared :objects; destinations/receivers are not counted as moved objects.

category_definitions.state_change_only: State action required; no On/In placement subjects.
category_definitions.state_change_and_object_placement: State action required and at least one placement subject.
category_definitions.multiple_object_placement: No required state action; at least two placement subjects.
category_definitions.single_object_placement: No required state action; exactly one placement subject, including pushing an object to a goal region.
category_definitions.unknown: Unsupported predicate/logic, unresolved placement subject/target, or neither recognized state action nor placement.

rules.conflicts: Keep both instruction sources and the complete BDDL goal. Language-only state commands and state-preservation predicates are explicit ambiguity notes; unknown is used when the categorical rule itself cannot be resolved.

limitations: The current frozen primary selection rule remains suite-only; this taxonomy does not amend it.
Any future comparison using these categories is exploratory unless independently preregistered before new evaluation outcomes.
Metadata categories alone cannot establish complementary paths, adaptive-selection value, causal layer specialization, or speedup.
Category sizes are unequal and strongly associated with suite identity; a future pooled category comparison must not silently attribute suite differences to semantics.
Official BDDL :init is a declared initialization constraint, not a fresh simulator measurement after settling.
